issues.failure_mechanism: Several JSONL/CSV/replace paths used ordinary Windows paths and could fail beyond MAX_PATH.
issues.fix: Central long-path-safe durable I/O and atomic replace used by all active artifact operations.

issues.failure_mechanism: Pinned GEPA and lineage could receive a long unprefixed run path even after artifact-writer repair.
issues.fix: Pass Windows-safe run_dir to unmodified official GEPA; append lineage through durable helper.
issues.proof: test_gepa_native_feed.py pinned long-run-dir search; full-stack rehearsals

issues.failure_mechanism: Lifecycle could become EXECUTION_COMPLETE before execution_summary persisted.
issues.fix: Atomically persist and read back summary before terminal COMPLETE; failure aborts.

issues.failure_mechanism: A deterministic local path/stale-root failure could consume one-time authorization before a provider call.
issues.fix: Fresh sibling readiness rehearsal and stale root/staging/temp checks before consumption; retain admission race recheck.

issues.failure_mechanism: Ledger identity was accepted in memory before durable append; persistence failure could leave inconsistent accounting or continued execution.
issues.fix: Record identity only after fsynced append, poison ledger on failure, and release capped reservation without continuing.

issues.failure_mechanism: A successful physical Solver request could be lost before logical completion, or local parse/extraction failure could be retried as a second provider request.
issues.fix: Immediately persist physical-success row, keep logical completion separate, and retry only transport failures.
issues.proof: test_pre_run_faults.py malformed response and post-provider parser failure

issues.failure_mechanism: Post-success source guard or malformed reflection response could be counted as failed provider call and retried.
issues.fix: Mark physical success before local extraction; record one success and abort local failure without retry.
issues.proof: test_pre_run_faults.py reflection callback and malformed response cases

issues.failure_mechanism: Upper exact-request cache hits were not represented as logical initialization rows, obscuring the required 5x100 denominator.
issues.fix: Durably emit zero-provider logical rows on both direct and in-flight cache hits; retain separate physical provider rows.
issues.proof: three full-stack rehearsals assert 500 initialization logical rows and accounting; offline auditor PASS

issues.failure_mechanism: Completed evidence could pass without all five readable initial member profiles or all 500 initialization logical rows.
issues.fix: Require exact initialization denominator and five 100-row profiles; missing/corrupt artifacts classify HOLD.
issues.proof: test_online_transfer_diagnostic.py strict completed fixture; test_pre_run_faults.py corrupt evidence

issues.failure_mechanism: Legacy freeze environment could monkey-patch unified provider clients or silently alter execution.
issues.fix: Skip legacy hook for unified CLI and reject legacy freeze variables before provider construction.
issues.proof: test_pre_run_faults.py fresh subprocess poison from three working directories

issues.failure_mechanism: Relative prep/run paths depended on launch CWD.
issues.fix: Resolve CLI paths against repository root for cross-CWD identity consistency.
issues.proof: test_pre_run_faults.py fresh subprocess across repository, scripts, unrelated CWD
